carpet.rule.haoZoneguard.name: haoZoneguard
carpet.rule.haoZoneguard.desc: Disables observers inside the cubic regions configured with /haoZoneguard. Turning the rule off restores observers in those regions.
carpet.rule.haoGoldenCarrotCompost.name: Golden Carrot Composting
carpet.rule.haoGoldenCarrotCompost.desc: While enabled, right-clicking a composter while holding a golden carrot composts it with 100% chance, exactly like a regular compostable item.
carpet.rule.haoSnowyCalcite.name: Snowy Calcite
carpet.rule.haoSnowyCalcite.desc: While enabled, stone/cobblestone produced by lava+water generators in snowy (snow-precipitating) biomes becomes calcite.
carpet.rule.haoNoEndPortalTeleport.name: No End Portal Teleport
carpet.rule.haoNoEndPortalTeleport.desc: Enables the /playerNoEndPortalTeleport list management. The rule itself does not change teleporting: only players added to the blacklist (or with globalMode enabled) are not teleported by end portals; non-player entities are unaffected.
carpet.rule.haoTerracottaUncolor.name: Terracotta Uncolor
carpet.rule.haoTerracottaUncolor.desc: While enabled, the stonecutter can revert all 16 dyed terracotta to plain terracotta and all 16 glazed terracotta to their dyed terracotta; while disabled, these recipes do not appear in the stonecutter at all.
carpet.rule.haoBedrockMines.name: Bedrock Can Be Mined
carpet.rule.haoBedrockMines.desc: While enabled, bedrock can be mined (it mines like obsidian) and drops itself as an item when broken; while disabled, vanilla behavior is restored.
globalMode [true|false] - view/set global mode (true = no player is teleported by end portals)
add <player> - add an online player to the no-teleport list
remove <player> - remove a player from the list
playerNoEndPortalTeleport.commands.add.s: Added %s to the end portal no-teleport list.
playerNoEndPortalTeleport.commands.globa: Global mode enabled: no player will be teleported by end portals.
Global mode disabled: only listed players are not teleported by end portals.

haoaddition.rule.exampleString.desc: An example string rule with a few preset options.

haoZoneguard.commands.help.line.clear: /haoZoneguard clear <id> - clear a region and restart its observers

carpet.rule.haoWitherSkeletonDrop.name: Wither Skeleton Drop Reduction
carpet.rule.haoWitherSkeletonDrop.desc: Removes selected drops from wither skeletons. Options: false=vanilla; bone=no bones; coal=no coal; skull=no wither skeleton skull; sword=no dropped stone sword; all=remove all of the above.
carpet.rule.haoDirectBlockDrops.name: Direct Block Drops
carpet.rule.haoDirectBlockDrops.desc: While enabled, drops produced by blocks the player breaks (including chain breaks, drops of blocks that lost support in the same tick, and items released from broken containers) go straight into that player's inventory; whatever does not fit still drops in the world as usual.
carpet.rule.haoDirectEntityDrops.name: Direct Entity Drops
carpet.rule.haoDirectEntityDrops.desc: While enabled, drops produced by killing an entity (mobs and armor stands, as well as minecarts, boats, paintings and item frames) go straight into that player's inventory; whatever does not fit still drops in the world as usual.
carpet.rule.haoLavaDepthStrider.name: Lava Depth Strider
carpet.rule.haoLavaDepthStrider.desc: While enabled, moving through lava no longer slows you down if you have Depth Strider: the water movement formula (and its water_movement_efficiency attribute) is applied to lava as well, so lava feels exactly like wearing Depth Strider boots in water. Higher enchantment levels move faster.
carpet.rule.haoProjectionWaterlogged.des: While following a schematic with easy place, fill in what has no placeable item and charge materials: water/bubble column costs ice, lava costs a magma block, a lava cauldron costs a magma block, fire/soul fire/nether portal costs a fire charge or flint-and-steel durability. Values: false=off; true=inventory only; shulker_direct=take from shulkers in your inventory; shulker_take=move from shulkers into your inventory. Requires Litematica. Default false.
carpet.rule.haoProjectionWaterloggedTrig: When the fill feature is allowed to run: always = both poses, standing or sneaking (default); standing = only while the player is not sneaking; sneaking = only while the player is sneaking (holding the sneak key).
carpet.rule.haoProjectionPlacement.name: Projection Placement
carpet.rule.haoProjectionPlacement.desc: When building from a schematic, places blocks with complex states (facing, toggle, color, block-entity data...) exactly as the schematic specifies. Requires Litematica. For waterlogged blocks use haoProjectionWaterlogged. Values: false = off (default); true = on, but a composter's fill level is not restored; with_composter_level = on, restores a composter's fill level too.
Lets waterlogged blocks be destroyed by explosions. Vanilla takes max(block resistance, fluid resistance) and water has a fluid resistance of 100, so waterlogged slabs/coral fans etc. survive TNT; when on, water's fluid resistance counts as 0. This only covers waterlogged blocks - for high-resistance blocks (obsidian/iron block/...) use 其它扩展's enhancedWorldEater. Off by default.
carpet.rule.haoCraftableTrimTemplates.de: When on, all 19 trim/upgrade smithing templates become craftable: 7 diamonds + 1 material taken from that template's original duplicating recipe (shipwreck -> cobblestone, desert temple -> sandstone, trail ruins -> terracotta, ...). Off by default.
carpet.rule.haoProjectionEntity.name: Easy Place Entities
carpet.rule.haoProjectionEntity.desc: While following a schematic with easy place, also spawns the schematic's entities (minecarts, boats, armor stands, item frames, paintings...) and consumes the matching items. Only entities with a matching item are supported; count is set by easyPlaceEntityCount. Spawns nothing if items are short. Off by default.
haoProjectionEntity.commands.uiStatus: Easy place entities: selector UI=%s, enabled=%s
haoProjectionEntity.commands.notEnabled: Note: the feature is not enabled yet; an operator must run /carpet haoProjectionEntity true.
haoProjectionEntity.commands.playerOnly: This command must be run by a player (the setting is stored per player).

carpet.rule.haoWackoBeacons.name: Wacko Beacons (client)
carpet.rule.haoWackoBeacons.desc: Client-side beacon unlock: Regeneration selectable as a primary effect, and effect buttons are no longer disabled by beacon tier. Ported from wacko-beacons.
carpet.rule.haoCopperStonecutting.name: Copper Stonecutting (equal value)
carpet.rule.haoCopperStonecutting.desc: Lets the stonecutter convert copper forms by equal value: any form to any form within a variant, plus 1:1 swaps between oxidation/waxed variants. New 26.x copper forms (bars/chain/chest/lantern/torch) are included, valued from vanilla recipes. Recipes ship as a datapack toggled by this rule. Off by default.
carpet.rule.haoUseDyeOnShulkerBox.name: Use dye on shulker box
carpet.rule.haoUseDyeOnShulkerBox.desc: Right-click a shulker box with dye to recolour it; sneak + right-click a coloured box while holding a cactus to wash it back to plain (the cactus is not consumed). Contents and custom name are preserved. Off by default.
carpet.rule.haoAutoMending.name: Auto mending (new)
carpet.rule.haoAutoMending.desc: Ported from Carpet WuHu Addition. Once a second, automatically spend the XP already accumulated in the level bar to repair damaged gear enchanted with Mending, repairing as much as that XP allows and deducting the same amount of XP (no free durability). Off by default.
carpet.rule.haoRocketShulker.name: Rocket Shulker Auto Refill
carpet.rule.haoRocketShulker.desc: For a shulker box named exactly 'rocket': when the chosen slot runs out of fireworks, refills one stack (up to 64) from the box, repeating until the box is empty. Set the slot with /haoRocketShulker offhand (default) or /haoRocketShulker mainhand <1-9>; kept in memory only. Never touches a slot holding something else. Off by default.

haoRocketShulker.commands.notEnabled: Note: the feature is not enabled yet; an operator must run /carpet haoRocketShulker true.
haoRocketShulker.commands.playerOnly: This command must be run by a player (the setting is stored per player).
